intent: Compare the percentage of people favoring versus opposing same-sex marriage across the years from 2001 to 2017 to determine how each share changed over time.

requirements.question: Are all required line series shown in every declared panel?
How did the percentage favoring same-sex marriage change from 2001 to 2017?
How did the percentage opposing same-sex marriage change from 2001 to 2017?
How did the favoring and opposing shares compare across the years from 2001 to 2017?

units.claim: All 2 required series appear in panel single chart.
accept: every required series is visible and correctly labeled in this panel
reject: series assigned to the wrong panel

units.claim: The percentage favoring same-sex marriage increased overall from 35% in 2001 to 62% in 2017, with a net increase of 27 percentage points.
units.computation: Compare first (2001: 35%) and last (2017: 62%) values; difference = 62 - 35 = 27 percentage points increase.
accept: Favoring share rose from 35% in 2001 to 62% in 2017.
Favoring share increased by 27 percentage points over the period.
reject: Favoring share decreased over the period.
Favoring share ended lower than it started.

units.claim: The percentage opposing same-sex marriage decreased overall from 57% in 2001 to 32% in 2017, with a net decrease of 25 percentage points.
units.computation: Compare first (2001: 57%) and last (2017: 32%) values; difference = 57 - 32 = 25 percentage points decrease.
accept: Opposing share fell from 57% in 2001 to 32% in 2017.
Opposing share decreased by 25 percentage points over the period.
reject: Opposing share increased over the period.
Opposing share ended higher than it started.

units.claim: The favoring share was below the opposing share through 2009, the two shares were equal at 49% in 2011, and the favoring share was higher by 2013 (50% vs 43%) and by 2017 (62% vs 32%).
units.computation: 2001: favoring 35 < opposing 57. 2009: favoring 37 < opposing 54. 2011: both equal 49. 2013: favoring 50 > opposing 43. 2017: favoring 62 > opposing 32.
accept: The favoring share is lower through 2009.
The two shares are equal at 49% in 2011.
The favoring share is higher in 2013 and 2017.
reject: Describes a strict crossing before 2011 while omitting the 2011 equality.
Claims favoring was already higher in 2009.

optional_valid: Mentioning that the favoring share dipped slightly from 35% in 2001 to 34% in 2003 before rising.
Mentioning that the opposing share was flat at 57% in 2001 and 2003 before declining.
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal explanations for the change in shares.
Claims about statistical significance or margin of error.
Claims about years not present in the table.
review_notes: The intent asks to compare favoring versus opposing shares and determine how each share changed over time; three semantic units cover the two trend slots and the cross-series comparison/crossing.
The crossing is evidenced by equality at 2011 (49% vs 49%) and reversal between 2009 and 2011.
Closure adjudication 2026-10-29: data_table.csv is authoritative; unlabeled plotted turns are retained when they belong to the series.
